# Rainbow Drop

Rainbow Drop is a lavender Pegasus mare seen among the Wonderbolt Academy cadets in *My Little Pony: Friendship is Magic*. Think of her as the pink-maned, raindrop-marked trainee from Rainbow Dash's flight camp, rather than an established member of the Wonderbolts.

- **Appearance:** Pale lavender coat, light pink mane, and a cutie mark catalogued as three blue raindrops. Her base design resembles Wild Fire and Meadow Flower. [Wonderbolt roster](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Wonderbolts) · [Cutie-mark catalogue](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks).
- **Name:** Rainbow Drop is a fandom catalogue name, not a verified on-screen or merchandise name. The [academy character list](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Wonderbolt_Academy_(location)) places it in quotation marks. The original coiner and naming date are unknown.
- **Speaking status:** No individual dialogue or voice actor verified; apparently a silent background cadet.
- **Appearances:** *Wonderbolts Academy* (S3E7, December 15, 2012) is the only appearance I could substantiate. No later episode, comic, or alternate identity was verified.

## Important moments

- **Training alongside Rainbow Dash — Wonderbolts Academy (S3E7):** Her appearance establishes her as one of the aspiring elite flyers in the episode about ambition and responsible teamwork. [Episode on Apple TV](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/wonderbolts-academy/umc.cmc.1pxpz5958tkbugvflmj8l8l4y?showId=umc.cmc.3ujevsytv3nqn8uolyrrgws8j); timestamp unavailable.

No second character-defining scene could be verified. I omitted an embedded image because the character-specific image asset and its contextual page could not both be verified. The roster and cutie-mark catalogue were available through indexed excerpts, but direct retrieval failed.
